course_outline_concepts: Data-constrained scaling (Muennighoff 2023): repeat vs new tokens, ~4-epoch threshold
Quality-vs-quantity scaling: quality shifts the irreducible-loss term
Physics-of-LM-3 (Allen-Zhu): linear capacity-per-parameter for fact storage; repetition as factual-recall knob
Decontamination design: n-gram overlap against eval suites, false-positive/false-negative tradeoff
2025 contamination-as-weapon risk: poisoned web data, upstream-of-scrape adversaries; bridge to Eval track

sources.what_to_extract: Unique vs repeated tokens; the effective-token decay formula with R_T scale parameter; ~4-epoch break-even; data-vs-parameter tradeoff under repetition.
2 bits/parameter capacity result; repetition as a factual-recall amplifier; how data budgets should be evaluated through stored-knowledge rather than only loss.
Quality as an explicit term in the scaling law; effective-sample-size framing; quality shifts the irreducible-loss asymptote, not just the coefficient.
Curse of recursion; tail-mass erasure; the accumulation-not-replacement rule as the defensive recipe; why the 2025 web is a collapse-risk source.
1% synthetic contamination flattens scaling laws; irreducible error c(p)·sigma² term; theoretical basis for the real-anchor requirement.
15.6T token budget; Llama 3's actual decontamination procedure (8-gram overlap); rejection-sampling pipeline uses decontamination as a filter stage.
OLMo-Mix-1124 + Dolmino cooldown; two-stage pretraining curriculum where cooldown data is decontaminated more aggressively than bulk pretraining.
Dolma 3 Mix with stronger decontamination than Dolma 3 source; OlmoTrace as a decontamination/dedup tool; 5.9T pretraining tokens — data-constrained even at 2025 scale.
Trigger-conditioned poisoning as the upstream-of-scrape adversary; safety training fails to remove latent conditional policy; the bridge from passive contamination to active data weaponisation.
